question: Do Aquanode's per-model 'from' prices, which include preemptible offers, and its pricing-page on-demand prices need two record fields?
why: the vendor quotes both an on-demand list price (H100 USD 2.78, A100 USD 1.49, L40S USD 1.07, RTX 4090 USD 0.760) and a lower live floor across preemptible offers (A100 USD 1.23, L40S USD 0.881, RTX 4090 USD 0.394); the draft keeps both in notes because no schema field separates on-demand from preemptible.
